title: Background characterization in the PIKACHU Phase 1 search for two-neutrino double-beta decay of $^{160}$Gd
byline: Omori; Iida; Gando; A; Hinohara; N; Hosokawa; Ishidate; Ishigami; Kishimoto; Mizukoshi; Sako; Sugi; Yoshino; Fushimi; Kamada; Shoji; Suga; Suzuki; Takahashi
html:
Abstract:We report a background characterization for the search for two-neutrino double-beta ($2\nu2\beta$) decay of $^{160}$Gd using Ce:Gd$_3$Al$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$ scintillators in the PIKACHU experiment Phase 1 at the Kamioka underground laboratory. The experimental backgrounds were investigated through delayed-coincidence analysis and spectral fitting based on GEANT4 simulations. In particular, surface contamination of the crystal was identified through the characteristic distortion of the $^{214}$Po $\alpha$-ray spectrum, leading to an improved background model that reproduces the observed energy spectra. No significant excess attributable to $^{160}$Gd $2\nu2\beta$ decay was observed, yielding a lower limit of $T^{2\nu}_{1/2} \geq 2.32 \times 10^{19}$ yr at 90\% C.L. The established background model and analysis framework provide a foundation for future PIKACHU phases aiming to discover $^{160}$Gd $2\nu2\beta$ decay.
